newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Norwegian ferry aground, passengers evacuated.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian ferry aground, passengers evacuated.

text.p: A Norwegian ferry has run aground near Sweden's western port of Stromstad in bad weather but all 33 passengers and many of the crew have been evacuated, Swedish radio reported on Friday.
The ferry Sandefjord issued a distress signal on Thursday night after running aground in strong winds, said a Swedish coastguard report.
The 33 passengers were evacuated, either by helicopter or by sliding down a chute into a rescue boat. Eleven of the 22 crew were also taken off the ferry.
A marine inspector was later airlifted onto the ferry.
